items.why: Caught in a global chipmaker selloff, with reports of a $1 trillion wipeout across AI chip names as doubts grow about AI investment returns.
Crude rallied after an unexpectedly large U.S. inventory draw, while attacks near the Strait of Hormuz keep a geopolitical risk premium in prices.
Pulled down with the broader AI chip selloff as investors rotate out of the AI trade; reports flag cracks forming in the AI-driven market.
Slid with high-beta tech as sticky inflation lifted rate fears, while analysts doubt the Roadster debut will do much for near-term earnings.

market_note: Treasury yields sinking as markets digest a hot wholesale inflation print.
summary: Rotation day on Wall Street: investors are dumping AI chip names and buying blue chips, with the Dow up about 400 points while the Nasdaq slides. A big crude inventory draw and sinking Treasury yields are steering the tape.
